summary: Strong B2.1+B2.2 lesson: fact-family triangles bridge from Lesson 1; trap names the count-back to count-up to fact-family-recall progression with branched recovery. Everyday materials with no-puppet fallback. Plus and Minnie anchor character work; doubles-as-3-facts treated as a discussable special case (math L4). Worksheet practises all three success criteria but largely replicates lesson activities rather than offering a justified transfer task, so consistency is L3 not L4.
